# Free template layout references

Created with the built-in imagegen tool before implementation.

- [Active template, desktop dark](active-desktop-dark.png)
- [Retained templates, mobile light](retained-mobile-light.png)

## Design extraction

Use the app’s existing Plus Jakarta Sans typography and violet theme. Make the active template the primary panel: selection status, a prominent Edit action, readable subject and message, and quiet download/delete controls. Use one border around the message panel with internal dividers. Keep plan guidance in an open sidebar on desktop and stack it below on mobile. The active message remains visible independently of pagination; retained templates have a separate list and a clear switching action. Hide redundant selected buttons and single-page pagination. Preserve existing editing and plan enforcement.

Implementation uses 24px desktop padding, 20px narrow-screen padding, 16px corners, quiet neutral borders, and a 280px desktop sidebar. Long messages scroll inside a keyboard-focusable region rather than stretching the whole page. Existing application header/navigation and 34px page headings take precedence over illustrative reference chrome.

## Desktop prompt

Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high-fidelity desktop section reference for Mailloop's Templates page, improving Free-plan users' experience. Product uses Plus Jakarta Sans body, Space Grotesk numerals, dark background #0b0a14, card #15132a, foreground #ece9ff, body #b1adc9, restrained violet #a58aff, quiet neutral borders. Render a readable 1440x1000 style desktop UI, no browser chrome. Preserve a modest mailloop wordmark and horizontal nav Compose Templates Contacts History Usage Settings with Templates selected. Main heading 'Write once, personalise for everyone.' and subtitle 'Create, edit, and manage the messages you use in Compose.' Below, a 2-column layout: wide active template panel 70% and a narrow open plan explanation 30%. Active panel header shows a small check icon badge 'Active for Compose', template name 'First introduction' at 22px, prominent violet 'Edit template' button on right. Thin divider. Plain content with small 'Subject' label and 'Exploring {{role}} opportunities at {{company}}', another subtle divider then readable message: 'Hi {{name}},' blank line 'I’m interested in {{role}} opportunities at {{company}}. I’d love to share my experience and learn more about your team.' blank line 'Thanks,' newline 'Anoop'. Do not nest cards within the panel. Footer below a divider with secondary 'Download JSON' and quiet 'Delete' actions. Adjacent sidebar, no glowing container: 'Free plan' subtle violet label, heading 'One template. Every introduction.', short clear copy 'Your plan includes one reusable template. Edit it anytime and personalise it for every recipient.' A thin rule then 'Need more templates?' and 'Paid includes unlimited saved templates.', violet 'View Paid plan →' link and subdued 'Upgrades coming soon.' Under main panel a small sentence 'Placeholders fill in each recipient’s details when you compose an email.' Clean spacing, 24px padding, 16px corners, no disabled selected button, no large empty areas, no generic lock banners, no decorative graphics. Focus on this main section only, no other saved templates list.

## Mobile retained-template prompt

Use case: ui-mockup. Fresh standalone mobile UI reference for Mailloop Templates' 'Other saved templates' section, 430px phone width displayed large in 1024x1536 portrait format, no phone bezel or browser. Light theme #f6f5fb background, white flat cards, dark #17142b text, readable muted #6b6788, restrained violet #6d4aff accents. Plus Jakarta Sans. Large readable text and margins 24px. Section heading 'Other saved templates', small count '2 retained'. Supporting text 'Your existing templates are kept. Choose one to replace the template available on Free.' Two simple single-level cards, no nested boxes. First card title 'Follow-up', plain subject line 'Following up on my application', clear outlined button 'Use as Free template'. Thin divider at bottom and secondary actions 'View full template' disclosure, 'Download JSON', 'Delete' placed with comfortable touch spacing and sensible wrapping. Second card 'Referral request', subject 'A quick introduction', same clear selection button and secondary controls. Finish with a quiet inline text link 'Back to your active template ↑'. Keep layout concise and readable with quiet borders and 16px radii, no glow, no lock icons, no repeated Paid labels on each card. The purpose is making retained data accessible and template switching obvious without implying multiple active Free templates.
